preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 1000
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 1000) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 3000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line is an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 3000) representing the number of cities.

preconditions.expression: all(len(lines) == n - 1 for lines in [stdin.splitlines()[i+1:i+n] for i in range(1, len(stdin.splitlines()), n+1)])
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n-1 lines describing roads, where each line contains two integers x_i, y_i (1 ≤ x_i, y_i ≤ n) representing a road between cities.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(y) <= n and x != y for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x, y in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_lines) == 2 * t for output_lines in [stdin.splitlines()[i:i+2] for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines()), n+1)])
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly 2 lines per test case: the first line is r (the minimum possible maximum roads assigned to any company), and the second line contains n-1 integers representing company assignments for each road.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(r_line) <= n - 1 for r_line in [stdin.splitlines()[i] for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines()), n+1)])
postconditions.description: The first line of each test case output is r, the minimum possible maximum number of roads assigned to any company, where 1 ≤ r ≤ n-1.

postconditions.expression: all(len(company_line.split()) == n - 1 for company_line in [stdin.splitlines()[i+1] for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines()), n+1)])
postconditions.description: The second line of each test case output contains exactly n-1 integers representing company assignments for each road.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(c) <= 10**6 for company_line in [stdin.splitlines()[i+1] for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines()), n+1)] for c in company_line.split())
postconditions.description: Each company assignment is an integer between 1 and 10^6.

postconditions.expression: all(any(company == c for company in company_line.split()) for company_line in [stdin.splitlines()[i+1] for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines()), n+1)] for c in company_line.split())
postconditions.description: The company assignments for each test case are valid (i.e., at least one company is used).

postconditions.expression: all(max(counts.values()) == int(r_line) for r_line, company_line in zip([stdin.splitlines()[i] for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines()), n+1)], [stdin.splitlines()[i+1] for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines()), n+1)]) for counts in [collections.Counter(company_line.split())])
postconditions.description: The value r is the maximum number of roads assigned to any single company in the assignment.

postconditions.expression: all(all(len(set(company for road, company in zip(roads, company_line.split()) if city in road)) <= 2 for city in range(1, n+1)) for n, roads, company_line in [(int(stdin.splitlines()[i]), [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[i+1:i+n]], stdin.splitlines()[i+n]) for i in range(1, len(stdin.splitlines()), n+1)])
postconditions.description: For each city, the number of different companies repairing roads connected to it does not exceed 2.
